text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayyyâ It's tomorrow, right?
That legit party! I'm so hyped~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, I was invited to attend a racing-related party
as a rookie trainer alongside my trainee Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —However, on the day of the event...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems
I've caught a cold...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling terrible about it, but knowing I couldn't risk spreading it,
I contacted the party organizers and Daitaku Helios
to let them know I wouldn't be attending.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, my cold had cleared up, and I made it back to work safely.
The first thing I needed to do was—
choice_data_list: (I have to apologize to Daitaku Helios...!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, maaan!
Looking like you're ready to party, huh!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!
Are you a pigeon that just swallowed a disco ball?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Btw, you free right now? Wanna come over for a sec?
choice_data_list: Huh? Sure, but more importantly, the other day—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Alrighty! Let's get going then~~☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tried to apologize, but before I could find the opening,
Daitaku Helios had already dashed off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Befuddled, the place I arrived at was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Oh, welcome!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the party♪ Are you ready to dance?
The music's about to start~!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hey, c'mon!!
Music, START☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Vroom-vroom-vroom, vrrrroooom!!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Everybody dancin'☆
The more you vibe, the more it's woo-hoo-hoo☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You dance too, Trainy-P☆
Dance and get hyped! Come on, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Next is this one! The juice tower!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Go all out, Trainer-pi! Show everyone your best side! ☆
...Wait, let me grab a drink too!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ghh~~~~~!! Delicious!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
An' last up is the decorated cake!
I wuv you for stuffing your face like crazy♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dragged out of nowhere to a club.
A party that started without me understanding a thing... but soon, I found myself in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Lookin' good, Trainie☆
Does this mean our party revenge was a success!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You know how you couldn't make it the other day?
To that legit party.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I got your super depressed message, so
I was wondering if you were spiraling, Trai-pi.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll throw us a party!
Keeping the vibes high is my specialty, after all☆

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, she was so pumped up
getting ready for today♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I finally understood.
In place of the party I couldn't attend before,
she had prepared today's event for me."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Nothin' to apologize for☆
Our party's only just gettin' started, right?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, wanna dance a bit more?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Real hardcore parties involve tons of dancing, right?
Shadow dancing? Or whatever it was? Not like I know, though!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah, should we do a huddle then?! Form up!?
Oryaryaryaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Embracing Daitaku Helios's feelings, I enjoyed
the rest of the day to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Btw, are we doing that thing for the party?
Like, a team project sorta thing?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
You mean cutting the cake together?
Isn't that usually done for—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yep! Into the bath!
Come on, Trai-pi and Palmer-chin! Into the bath!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's kind of different, but... oh well♪
New entry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We all shared another toast. And so,
we were able to spend a wonderful day together.
